chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The hadd of zina is among the most severe that the legal punishments can be.

key_terms.أَشَدِّ: most severe or most intense in degree
key_terms.الزِّنَى: illicit sexual intercourse subject to legal punishment
key_terms.الْحُدُودِ: fixed legal punishments ordained in Islamic law
key_terms.حَدُّ: the prescribed legal punishment established by sacred law

ai.seo_question: How severe is the hadd punishment for zina in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the prescribed punishment for zina is among the most severe of the hudud. It underscores the grave legal status of zina within Islamic jurisprudence and reflects the seriousness with which sacred law treats violations of sexual morality.
